---
title: "Plan critique"
---

::: {.npr-disclaimer}
Educational use only. **Do not enter protected health information** — no names, MRNs, dates of
birth, or other identifiers. The tutor is a teaching aid fed a deterministic model as ground
truth; it does not issue medical orders. Always confirm with your fellow or attending.
:::

Set the patient state on the left, then either paste your assessment and plan for a critique,
ask the tutor a focused question, or read the deterministic engine brief directly.

```{=html}
<div class="npr-layout">
  <div id="npr-critique-panel"></div>
  <div id="npr-critique-tabs"></div>
</div>
<script type="module" src="js/npr-page-critique.js"></script>
```
